label: Flammability, mid-century
description: ALFRESCO relative flammability: average chance of burning per year
method: ALFRESCO relative flammability: the average chance that a 1 km cell burns in a year, over 2040–2069, for the average of five CMIP5 models (5modelAvg) under RCP 4.5. Source: SNAP Rasdaman coverage alfresco_relative_flammability_30yr (era 2040–2069, model 5modelAvg, scenario RCP 4.5), already on a 1 km EPSG:3338 grid; used as is (nearest cell). Cells the model treats as not burnable have no value.
pros: Direct model estimate of how likely a place is to burn at mid-century
Same 1 km grid, period and scenario (5-model average, RCP 4.5) as the permafrost index
cons: SNAP advises against reading single ALFRESCO pixels: the map is noisy
26 % of land is exactly 0: a quarter of the state ties at the bottom of the scale
About 20 % of land is not burnable and has no value
Which fire-management version Rasdaman serves is not documented
author: Joshdpaul
